# ProAvanti x Kuailu Smart Office: AI+ Digital Upgrade controls transnational business!

- Publication channel: China Daily News Network (central media)
- Release time: 2026-03-20
- Original link: [https://caijing.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202603/20/WS69bcaa05a310942cc49a4103.html](https://caijing.chinadaily.com.cn/a/202603/20/WS69bcaa05a310942cc49a4103.html]

## Text
Intelligent medical equipment is a key area of human safety, and under the wave of digital technologies, it is moving towards intellectualization, greening and fine-tuning of the equipment, and its management processes are becoming an engine of two-way growth in the efficiency and effectiveness of enterprises.

ProAvanti is an Italian provider of specialized medical and automation equipment solutions, focusing on the field of hospital uniform distribution systems, whose products are widely used in major hospitals around the world, and is a leader in high-end automation equipment distribution services. Recently, ProAvanti has formally joined forces with Kuailu ' s Smart Office to introduce a customized "AI+CRM /EMS /WMS" integrated platform that will comprehensively enhance cross-regional collaboration, after-sales service responsiveness and achieve process-wide data continuity and cost-effective growth!

Depth Enabling Medical Equipment

ProAvanti is a typical medical equipment enterprise, operating in a wide range of locations, including mainland China, Port/Australasia, and Viet Nam, Singapore, with internal functions covering a wide range of roles, including sales, procurement, administration, technical support, installation and maintenance. As enterprises grow larger, they often face the following problems in their daily operations:

• Multi-regional processes are synergistic: as multinational enterprises, cross-regional synergies have poor information and communication faults, severely constrain operational efficiency and high cross-sectoral communication costs!

• Multiple SKU, multi-processors: equipment, spare parts, uniform type / size in parallel management, no match, not available, unclear inventory!

• Strong post-sale properties: the long-term after delivery of equipment involves maintenance, maintenance, replacement of spare parts and requires faster response to win the market!

With a view to long-term enterprise development planning, ProAvanti hopes to create a secure compliance, data connection, and professional integrated business management platform, which will allow business-wide data to be interoperable, ProAvanti works with Kuailu to formally launch a new era of intelligent office with the technical advantages of a unified data base and full coverage of AI intelligence.

Customised on demand, integrated construction

Building an enterprise development think tank

In response to ProAvanti's pain, Kuailu's Smart Office created an integrated management platform for it, “AI+CRM / EMS / WMS”, which covers multiple lines of marketing, finance, after-sale, etc., resulting in the digitization of the entire process from clue to sale.

Management cockpit, 1 panel full visualization

The Kuailu Smart Office has developed a full-process business digitization system for it, and management has built the BI Data Panel; Full life-cycle coverage is achieved by automating custom forms and processes.

Smart CRM module, business opportunities are traceable

Follow-up alerts are provided through a life-cycle management from lead, business opportunities to customers to help sales science operators follow up and make scientific decisions; at the same time, advance revenue expectations are captured and management is able to obtain a clear picture of sales team performance.

Smart storage management, after sale

Maintenance worksheets are linked to inventory intelligence, parts selected for use by technicians in maintenance worksheets, systems will automatically deduct stocks in real time, and real-time mapping mechanisms for “maintenance worksheets-material inventory” are established to avoid manual registration errors.

Standardized output to ensure consistency of key documents

Smart Printing and Professional Documents: All use systematic forms such as quotations, POs, PIs, maintenance worksheets, uniform forms model + template printing, generate standardized PDFs with specific exemption clauses, and ensure professionalism and consistency in file material exported externally.

Data flow, automation of cost management

The upgrade of reimbursement from “manual flow” to “automated management” resulted in over-reimbursement of individual claims, digitization of claims and acceleration of the process of cost approval.

AID Depth, full speed.

During the critical period of AI ' s value landing, Kuailu ' s smart office is based on a unified data base, driven by AI ' s smart body, which integrates AI ' s office, AI ' s collaboration, AI ' s conference landscape office ecology, the smart body needed to move consistent data and depths to fit scenes, enabling enterprise intelligence decision-making, intellectual drive. The Digital Upgrading Project in ProAvanti is also fully integrated with its actual needs, incorporating AI ' s prognosis, analytical and interactive advantages, ancillary business effectiveness and enterprise-level decision-making.

The AI smart body needs to fit the scene:

Equipment AI forecast maintenance: Based on ProAvanti ' s years of accumulated equipment maintenance records, spare parts consumption data, terminal customer equipment operations, construction of the AI model, early warning equipment failure and loss of perishable items, automatic production of spare parts procurement proposals, passive maintenance as a proactive precaution, projected 30 per cent reduction in unplanned downtime.

Inventory smart warning and automatic replenishment: AI, combined with sales forecasts, maintenance worksheet trends and procurement cycles, dynamic calculations of safe stock thresholds, automatically triggers procurement requests when inventory is below the warning line and avoids delivery delays due to missing items.

Sales funnel AI analysis: AI Autoanalysing Businesses to follow up on the recording of interactions with customers, predicts single probability and gives "best action next" recommendations to help local sales teams focus on high-value leads and is expected to further increase conversion rates by over 20 per cent.

AI Universalisation of the System

Kuailu Cloud AI has built a standardized API for smart office, AI assistant question-and-answer, data insight, etc. The existing OA, HR, and write-off systems of the enterprise are quickly accessible and system-wide smartening is achieved.

Cross-system data intelligence questions and answers: Managers can ask questions directly by voice or text, such as "Hong Kong branch collects forecasts for this quarter", "current stock turnover days", AI automatically retrieves data from business systems such as ERP, CRM, WMS, and generate visual analysis results in graph form without waiting for the IT department to issue a statement.

Smart CRM Operations with Clients: AI consolidates a 360-degree image of the customer ' s full life cycle data, automatically generates recommendations for customer follow-up strategies and conversions, automatically triggers a high-value trail of customer follow-up for the end of the protection period, helps to optimize the distribution of resources and precision control.

Improved intelligence in the enabling industry with AI+ intelligence

The Kuailu smart office has been online for months, and ProAvanti has witnessed a significant business change:

- • Inventory accuracy rate surged to 99%+: the problem of “inconsistent data on inventory parts” was completely resolved and the manual search and inventory time was significantly reduced.
- • 20 per cent improvement in sales performance: The client conversion rate has improved significantly thanks to the fine-tuning management of the CRM digitization system and business opportunities.
- • Cross-sectoral management upgrades: Sales, maintenance, procurement, warehousing, costs, collaboration under the same system, departure from inefficient operating methods such as spreadsheets, mail, paper printing, etc.

ProAvanti ' s case proves that when AI is profoundly changing the boundaries of the ability of an enterprise to upgrade its intelligence, from a technological engine to a productivity dividend, it will further activate its productivity. Kuailu, as a pioneer in the intellectual field, uses AI ' s smart body as an engine for integrating AI office, AI collaboration, AI conference-wide office ecology, and is committed to helping more leaders in intelligent equipment such as ProAvanti to build smart, efficient digital moats.
